_comment: Font manifest for the Blank Inheritance visual identity. Consumed by build_fonts.py, which downloads from Google Fonts, subsets, converts to woff2, and writes module/blank-inheritance/assets/fonts/ plus the generated bi-fonts.css. Every family here is SIL Open Font License, so bundling and redistribution inside the module is fine.

_profiles.full: Latin + punctuation + kana + the common CJK ideograph block. ~2.8MB per weight in Mincho. ONLY for faces that must render arbitrary Japanese a GM might type — realistically just the document body face.
_profiles.ui: Latin + punctuation + kana + a curated kanji vocabulary (below). ~85KB per weight. For display faces that only ever render strings WE author — stamps, legends, headings. If a new Kanji is added to the UI it must be added to uiKanji and the fonts rebuilt, or it will render in a fallback face.
_profiles.latin: No CJK. Latin-only families, converted to woff2 and otherwise untouched.

families.name: Shippori Mincho
families.role: Document body and titles. The one face that must render arbitrary Japanese.

families.name: Zen Old Mincho
families.role: Retro display Mincho — document headings, section marks.

families.name: Klee One
families.role: Pen/textbook hand. Handwritten annotations and margin notes on documents.

families.name: Yuji Syuku
families.role: Brush calligraphy. Seals, stamps, anything that should look inked by hand.

families.name: DotGothic16
families.role: Bitmap/pixel Japanese. The phone OS — see terminal-login-landing-page's locked chunky-pixel art direction.

families.name: Noto Sans JP
families.role: Gothic workhorse for hard administrative markings.

families.name: Zen Kaku Gothic New
families.role: Clean gothic. Panel legends in Japanese.

families.name: RocknRoll One
families.role: Rounded gothic. The phone's friendlier corners.

families.name: Saira Stencil One
families.role: Military stencil. Crate markings, hull numbers, classification banners.

families.name: Special Elite
families.role: Imperfect typewriter — uneven strike. The 1950s typed-document face.

families.name: Courier Prime
families.role: Clean typewriter. Form fields and control numbers where Special Elite is too noisy.

families.name: Chakra Petch
families.role: Squared techno. Panel legends, key caps.

families.name: Oxanium
families.role: Retro-futurist display. Headings on the glass register.

families.name: Michroma
families.role: Wide techno. Marquee and wordmark use.

families.name: Share Tech Mono
families.role: HUD numerals. Narrow, technical, reads at small sizes on phosphor.

families.name: IBM Plex Mono
families.role: Technical mono for dense readouts and log lines.

families.name: Spectral
families.role: Book serif for Latin document text, paired with Shippori for Japanese.

families.name: Bruno Ace
families.role: Engraved panel legends. Also ships with Foundry; bundled so it is certain.

families.name: Bruno Ace SC
families.role: Small-caps display variant.

families.name: Rajdhani
families.role: Condensed techno. Tight labels where Chakra Petch is too wide.

families.name: Press Start 2P
families.role: Pixel Latin. The phone OS, paired with DotGothic16.

families.name: Antonio
families.role: Condensed poster. Marquee headlines, alert banners.
